title: Welcome
summary: The first screen when the phone has no Bipe account. A short cover says what Bipe is and links to the site. Below it are two choices of equal width: the filled button that starts sign-up, and a quieter button for people who already have an account. The button depends on the invite state (registries/onboarding.json start).

code.description: The invite code, normalised (BipeInviteLink.normalizedCode on iOS). Never shown in full.

inviterHandle.description: The inviter's handle without @, from GET /v1/invites/{code}. Absent when the invite has none or is not valid.

variant.description: loading: GET /v1/signup/config runs (at most 3 s, then inviteOnly). invited, inviteOnly, open: the start variant of registries/onboarding.json that matches invitePending and inviteRequired.

invite.description: The invite that came with a link, the install referrer (Android) or a paste. Its presence is invitePending.

inviteRequired.description: invite_required from GET /v1/signup/config. true when the app cannot read it.

termsVersion.description: terms_version from GET /v1/signup/config. signup-name sends it after the checkbox.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/signup/config and, when an invite is pending, GET /v1/invites/{code}. On Android it also reads the Play install referrer once (bipeinstallreferrer). Sets variant.

url.description: A bipe.chat/convite/<code> or bipe.chat/g/<code> link the app was opened with or that pasteLink read.

openInviteLink.effect: Takes the code from the link, previews it and sets variant to invited. A link that is not an invite does nothing.

primary.effect: Follows the primary button of the variant: invited and open go to signup-name with the invite (if any); inviteOnly goes to signup-invite-code. A pending invite is checked again with GET /v1/invites/{code} first (bipe-chat/bipe#460): valid false goes to signup-invite-code with bipe_invite_no_longer_valid under the field; no network keeps the invite and goes on, as signup-create checks it again.

learnMore.effect: Opens the public site home page in the in-app browser (SFSafariViewController on iOS, Custom Tabs on Android): PUBLIC_SITE_URL plus registries/legal.json homePath, or enHomePath on an English device. The sign-up state stays as it was.

pasteLink.effect: iOS only, shown while no invite is pending and UIPasteboard.detectPatterns finds probableWebURL (no paste prompt): the line bipe_onboarding_paste_link next to the system PasteButton. The pasted text runs openInviteLink with the first bipe.chat/convite/ or bipe.chat/g/ link in it. A group link code is also kept for group-link-open. Other text does nothing. The deferred link of iOS: the bipe.chat/g/ and bipe.chat/convite/ pages copy the link when the person taps the App Store button.

haveAccount.effect: Opens the way back into an existing account (recovery-start, bipe-chat/bipe#555).

openLanguageRegion.effect: Opens language-region as a sheet (ADR 0197, ADR 0298).

notes: A quiet row on the cover shows the app language and the region, for example 'Português · Brasil' (language name · region name, from language-region). Its accessibility label is bipe_settings_language_region. It runs openLanguageRegion.

Each pair of invitePending and inviteRequired matches exactly one start variant in registries/onboarding.json. The generated onboarding code (gen.mjs) gives the title and buttons; the screen never hard-codes them.

No points list: the welcome line and the title say what Bipe is. The scam check, Brazil and no-ads points belong to the store listing and the site (product/appstore.md), not to this screen. The bipe_onboarding_point_* strings stay for those surfaces.

Layout: a full-bleed açaí cover with the Bipe mark, the wordmark, the welcome line and the title; the cover also holds learnMore. The cover is not an inset card. Under it, the variant's primary button (filled) and its text buttons (haveAccount) as a tonal button of the same width. A tall window gives the cover all the height above the buttons; a wide window makes the cover the left half of the whole window, so the split meets the iPhone Duo fold. No paste row here: pasting a code belongs to signup-invite-code. The one exception is pasteLink on iOS, a text button under haveAccount that shows only while the clipboard holds a URL, because iOS has no install referrer.
bipe_onboarding_invited_by takes the inviter's handle with @ in front. An invite without a handle, or not valid, shows the open or inviteOnly variant and keeps the code for signup-invite-code.

The screen talks only to bipe-api (no auth). The Matrix client does not exist yet. Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.signupConfig and invitePreview, BipeInviteLink (iOS); BipeApiClient, BipeStartScreenInfo (Android).
account-start shows this screen when its phase is noAccount.

The cover ends with the app version in small, faded text: the same version name, build and commit as bipe_help_version in Settings ("1.0.0 (412) abc1234"), so a tester sees which build runs before sign-up. It is not a string resource and has no action.
